demos.name: Privilege A2A Anthropic Demo LAB
demos.description: Three-process A2A and MCP demo: preset access-review prompts travel Main Agent -> A2A -> Worker Agent -> MCP tool, with a per-hop trace, agent-scope claims, and model calls routed through PingOne Privilege (Anthropic, Google, Groq or llama.cpp). Real mode talks to a configured provider or Privilege gateway; without credentials it runs the same flow on mock model calls. Ports 6881-6883.
demos.notes: No catalog row matches this app yet (closest row D118 'AI Gateway Suite' is a different repo on port 5750); catalogId null until the owner adds one. No docker-compose.yml ships yet (Dockerfile + k8s/deployment.yaml only); composeFile is a placeholder. Host-run: npm run dev (main agent on 6881). No docker compose verified for this lab.
